name: ospa-brain
goal: Turn a non-technical user's plain-language request into gated ActionPlans, doing 90% locally (free) and escalating only the hard ~10% to a cloud model with a tight, redacted task spec.
principles: local-first: local Qwen3-VL-8B (MLX) handles routing, reading, planning, easy steps
escalate-not-default: cloud is called only when the evaluator gate fails
structure-first web: fetch+readability -> a11y/DOM browser -> vision (last resort)
brain emits ActionPlans only; OSPA consent/preflight/audit gates stay terminal
redact before any cloud handoff: no secrets, no raw page dumps, no AX labels
hand CAPTCHAs/logins back to the human, never auto-solve

cloud_hard_step.input: redacted task spec drafted by local_planner
cloud_hard_step.scope: one bounded step, do exactly what the spec says

handoff_contract.redaction: no secrets, no credentials, no raw page text, no AX labels

failure_and_cost_controls.context_discipline: local reads verbose context; only distilled bounded spec crosses to cloud, never full page/history
